title: 'My Heart, My Fellow Traveller': Fantasy, Futurity and the Itineraries of Faiz Ahmed Faiz

publication.publisher_or_container: South Asia: Journal of South Asian Studies, Vol. 39, No. 3

verification.verification_notes: Scholarly article on Faiz's futurity confirmed via Taylor & Francis and Faiz reception records; supports analysis of the nazm's forward-facing, anticipatory structure and its circulation.
